facts.business: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of pharmaceutical products across domestic and international markets with strengths in complex chemistry, biologics, and injectables.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Expand scale in cardio-metabolic and women's health segments
Build new growth areas including CNS, dermatology, onco and consumer health
Accelerate growth in Canada and Europe through in-house launches and inorganic expansion
Expand RoW markets through biosimilars, complex injectables and non-ARV products
Progress near-term assets across obesity, ophthalmology, oncology, anti-infectives and HIV
Continue investing in biologics, complex injectables, novel delivery platforms and antibody drug conjugates

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to incentives or external pressures to meet expectations resulting in revenue being overstated or recognized before control has been transferred
